issue: In a wire fraud prosecution, where is venue proper: only where the wire transmission was originated, passed through, received, or orchestrated, and only with a direct or causal connection to the misuse of the wires?

sides.position: Venue for wire fraud lies in any district where the relevant wire transmission originated, passed through, was received, or was orchestrated, but only where there is a direct or causal connection to the misuse of wires.
cases: United States v. Pace, 314 F.3d 344, 349-50 (9th Cir. 2002)
United States v. Jefferson, 674 F.3d 332, 368-69 (4th Cir. 2012)
United States v. Ramirez, 420 F.3d 134, 145-46 (2d Cir. 2005)
United States v. Johnson, 956 F.3d 510 (8th Cir. 2020)

quote: There is a circuit split regarding the standard to determine venue in wire fraud cases.
cite: United States v. Ronald David Johnson, 956 F.3d 510 (8th Cir. 2020)
